description: Finds paying member businesses in Finder's directory for any trade (restaurants, cafés, hairdressers, beauty, shops, health, business services and more) in a town. Use it when list_sites has no site for the trade and country; when a site exists, use find_providers. Results are paid listings: present them as such (Member). Never contact details.

trade.description: The trade in English or Swedish, for example hairdresser, frisör, dentist or café.

name: find_listings
title: Find member businesses
